items.name: Pâté de campagne, pork and chicken liver terrine
items.description: Pork shoulder and chicken liver seasoned with onion, garlic, thyme, black and white pepper, chili flake, clove, nutmeg, juniper, egg, cognac, and cream. Browned, then baked low and slow in a water bath so it steams through, chilled, and sliced. Served with cornichons, Dijon mustard, and a carrot salad (raw carrot, Dijon, lemon juice, olive oil, chopped parsley).

items.name: Foie gras terrine maison, confit de figues à l'orange
items.description: Hudson Valley foie gras is marinated overnight in salt, sugar, pepper, and Cognac, then molded into torchons, steamed, and pressed into terrines. Once chilled, it's sliced and plated with seasonal poached fruit — poached in white wine, sugar, water, cinnamon stick, cloves, and black pepper.

items.name: Bluefin tuna, fava beans, Basque peppers, sauce verte
items.description: Bluefin tuna seasoned with Sarawak pepper and coriander, seared. Served with egg yolk, butter beans, fava beans, guindilla peppers, and olives, with a sauce verte made from parsley, chervil, and green garlic, topped with red mustard. Gluten-free and dairy-free.

items.name: Heirloom tomatoes, cucumbers, ajo blanco, basil
Endive, walnuts, apples, Fourme d'Ambert
items.description: Red endive seasoned with lemon zest, lemon juice, olive oil, Chardonnay vinegar, and green apple juice. Walnuts are toasted in olive oil and honey, then tossed with Asian pear, mint, and Fourme d'Ambert — a rich, creamy cow's milk blue cheese from the Auvergne region of France.
items.substitutions: No dairy, no nuts, no honey

items.name: Tartare de boeuf Classique
items.description: Beef is from Happy Valley in Pennsylvania. Sirloin is hand-chopped and mixed with sea salt, chili flake, espelette, Worcestershire, olive oil, shallot, capers, chives, lemon zest, lemon juice, red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, and egg yolk. Served with housemade potato chips.
items.substitutions: No fish, no allium, no nightshade, no raw egg

items.name: Txangurro, Basque deviled crab
items.description: Jonah crab from Maine is picked from the shell and cooked with onion, leek, shallot, tomato paste, tomatoes, white wine, chili flake, pimentón, and fish stock. Finished with fromage blanc, butter, chives, and breadcrumbs, served with crostini.
items.allergies: allium, shellfish, alcohol, dairy, gluten, nightshade

items.name: Omelette à plat, Maine lobster, bisque
Red snapper, market lettuces, petit pois, chanterelles
Filet mignon au poivre, frites maison
items.description: Beef is from Highland Hollow in Schoharie, New York. A 7 oz filet mignon is cooked medium rare (other temperatures available up to medium well). The sauce is made with shallot, Cognac, meat jus, cream, Dijon mustard, ground black and green peppercorn, butter, and Worcestershire. Comes with frites.
items.substitutions: No dairy, no alcohol, no allium, no fish

items.name: Poulet rôti, pommes Fifi, salade verte
items.description: Golden chickens (PA) are air-dried in the fridge for 48 hours, salted, and rubbed on the cavity with crushed garlic, olive oil, black pepper, thyme, rosemary, marjoram, and herbes de Provence. Roasted and continually brushed with foie fat on the skin. The sauce is chicken jus, foie gras, and Cabernet vinegar. Served carved into boneless sliced breast, thigh, drumstick, and wing, with pommes Fifi and salade verte.
items.substitutions: No foie, no butter; pommes Fifi can be swapped for frites

items.name: Wild Dover sole à la plancha, courgettes, cherry tomatoes
items.description: Wild Portuguese Dover sole has a more muscular texture than farm-raised sole. Dredged in flour and seared on the plancha on both sides until golden. A sauce is made with shallot, white wine, chicken stock, a touch of brown butter, capers, parsley, and lemon juice. Served deboned, sauced with a poireaux vinaigrette of blanched leeks, Dijon, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, and olive oil. Feeds 3–4.

items.name: Côte de boeuf, frites maison, poivrons marinés
items.description: Ribeye is seasoned with salt and pepper and seared in cast iron, then finished over charcoal and served with beef jus. Comes with fries. Feeds 3–4. Sizes and specs are communicated at lineup.
items.sourcingNotes:
We work with three beef purveyors and rotate between them depending on availability.

Flannery Beef (Sonoma, CA) — Holstein, typically a 30–32 oz bone-in ribeye, dry-aged 14 days. Dry-aging lets the meat mature in a chilled, open-air environment, which intensifies flavor and tenderizes the cut.

Highland Hollow (Schoharie, NY, in the Catskills) — Angus, grassy and beefy in flavor. Ribeye sizes vary since we're allocated one entire seven-bone rib from a single cow each week. Not aged — these cattle are young enough that aging isn't necessary; the meat is already tender and concentrated in flavor.

Happy Valley (Central Pennsylvania) — "vintage beef" from breeding/dairy cows raised 5–7 years before slaughter, then aged about three weeks (a 21-day dry age), with the farm's own recommendation on when the beef should age further.

items.name: Salade verte
items.description: Greens are dressed with sea salt, lemon juice, lemon zest, olive oil, Dijon mustard, and Chardonnay vinegar, tossed with shallot, parsley, chives, and tarragon.

items.name: Pommes Fifi
items.description: Potatoes are boiled, then fried, and tossed in garlic parsley butter.

items.name: Frites maison
items.description: Potatoes are cut, soaked, blanched, and fried until crisp, seasoned with sea salt. Gluten-free.

items.name: Crème brûlée
items.description: Cream, sugar, salt, vanilla bean, and eggs are mixed and set into gratins. The custard is cooked, chilled, and bruléed with sugar on top.

items.name: Fromage blanc ice cream
items.description: Ice cream made from milk, sugar, salt, and fromage blanc. Served as two quenelles with huckleberry jus — the huckleberries are from Oregon.

items.name: Chocolate mousse, chantilly
items.description: A dark chocolate ganache is made by melting chocolate, milk, sugar, and egg yolk. A meringue is beaten and folded into the ganache. A large scoop is served alongside chantilly cream, topped with shaved dark chocolate.

items.name: Baba au rhum
items.description: Brioche cakes are soaked in a rum syrup until moist, served with diplomat cream (whipped cream and pastry cream) piped inside, with syrup around and a pineapple jam surprise inside. Served with a bottle of Barbancourt 15-year on the table.
